title: Everyday Beam Analysis: Shear Force, Bending Moment & Section Modulus Sizing
description:
A civil engineer is designing a temporary steel shoring beam supporting a roadway trench plate over an excavation.

The beam is simply supported with span L = 24.0 ft. It carries a uniform dead load w = 1.20 kips/ft (including beam self-weight) plus a concentrated wheel point load P = 16.0 kips located at a = 8.0 ft from the left support (b = 16.0 ft from the right support).

• Left Reaction:
  R_1 = [ w · L / 2 ] + [ P · b / L ] = [ 1.20 · 24 / 2 ] + [ 16.0 · 16 / 24 ] = 14.40 + 10.67 = 25.07 kips
• Right Reaction:
  R_2 = [ w · L / 2 ] + [ P · a / L ] = [ 1.20 · 24 / 2 ] + [ 16.0 · 8 / 24 ] = 14.40 + 5.33 = 19.73 kips
• Maximum Shear Force occurs immediately inside the left support: V_max = 25.07 kips.
• Location of Zero Shear (x_zero from left):
  V(x) = R_1 - w · x - P = 0 → At x = 8.0 ft (just under the point load), V drops from (25.07 - 1.2·8 = +15.47 kips) to (15.47 - 16.0 = -0.53 kips). Thus, zero shear occurs at x = 8.0 ft.
• Maximum Bending Moment at x = 8.0 ft:
  M_max = R_1 · x - w · x² / 2 = 25.07 · 8.0 - 1.20 · 8.0² / 2 = 200.56 - 38.40 = 162.16 kip-ft = 1,946 kip-in.

The beam is ASTM A992 structural steel with yield strength F_y = 50 ksi and allowable bending stress F_b = 0.66 · F_y = 33.0 ksi.

Determine:
1. The maximum bending moment M_max (kip-ft)
2. The minimum required elastic section modulus S_req = M_max · 12 / F_b (in³)

The maximum bending moment M_max and required section modulus S_req are most nearly:

options.label: A
options.feedback: Incorrect. 144 kip-ft only accounts for the uniform distributed load without the 16-kip wheel load.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Incorrect. Did you place the point load at midspan? The point load is at x = 8.0 ft.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Incorrect. Did you use F_y = 50 ksi directly without the safety factor? Allowable stress is F_b = 33.0 ksi.

hint: Step 1: Reactions: R_1 = 1.2(24)/2 + 16(16)/24 = 14.4 + 10.67 = 25.07 kips. Step 2: Zero shear occurs at point load position x = 8.0 ft. Step 3: M_max = 25.07(8) - 0.5(1.2)(8)² = 200.56 - 38.4 = 162.16 kip-ft. Step 4: Convert to kip-in: 162.16 · 12 = 1,945.9 kip-in. Step 5: S_req = M / F_b = 1945.9 / 33 = 58.97 in³.
shortcut: Superposition shortcut: M_uniform at x=8 is (w·x/2)·(L - x) = (1.2·8/2)·(16) = 76.8 kip-ft. M_point is P·a·b / L = 16·8·16 / 24 = 85.33 kip-ft. M_total = 76.8 + 85.33 = 162.13 kip-ft! S_req = 162.13 · 12 / 33 = 59.0 in³.
fifthGrader: Think of a heavy wooden plank across a ditch. When a car wheel stops on the plank, it bends downwards the most right under the tire! We calculate the exact bending pressure (moment) so we can pick a steel beam strong and stiff enough that it doesn't sag or snap!
